messages:
kai: Heads-up: seeing intermittent 502/504s in staging. Traced to DNS — same svc name resolves to internal cluster IP from CoreDNS but to an old external A record from the host resolver. Repro on two different nodes.

maria: which svc/name? any recent kubelet/node-image changes?

kai: svc.foo.svc.cluster.local. Quick repro:
```
# query cluster DNS (10.96.0.10)
$ dig @10.96.0.10 svc.foo.svc.cluster.local +short
10.0.5.12

# query host resolver (127.0.0.53 -> systemd-resolved)
$ dig @127.0.0.53 svc.foo.svc.cluster.local +short
34.210.77.9
```
The external IP (34.210.77.9) is an old public record we retired months ago. Pods hitting the external IP get blocked by egress/NAT -> 502s.

jon: that smells like resolv.conf ordering / ndots / search differences. Can you paste /etc/resolv.conf from a pod and the host?

kai: pod resolv.conf (from exec -> cat /etc/resolv.conf):
```
nameserver 127.0.0.53
options ndots:5
search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
```
host /etc/resolv.conf shows the cluster IP first:
```
nameserver 10.96.0.10
nameserver 1.1.1.1
```
So kubelet/node-local-dns seems to be pointing pods at 127.0.0.53 (systemd-resolved) not the cluster DNS.

maria: did we just roll an OS image with a different systemd/networkmanager behavior? infra-bot, any recent node-image rollouts?

infra-bot: node-image-rollout: image-builder/pipeline #2023 completed 2026-03-16T18:02:04Z -> rolled to staging pool (batch size 20%). Changes: systemd 255.x -> 259.x, resolved config tweak.

jon: that lines up. systemd-resolved can register itself as the local resolver at 127.0.0.53 and /etc/resolv.conf gets symlinked to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf. Kubelet's --resolv-conf defaults to /etc/resolv.conf which now points at systemd's stub. Pods therefore see the stub resolver which may return cached/stale answers or perform different search/ndots behavior.

alex: negative/TTL cache behavior matters here too — if systemd-resolved previously cached an external A and then cluster svc got created later, the stub resolver might keep returning the stale external answer until TTL expires. glibc caches NXDOMAIN/positive answers too.

jon: mitigation options (short term):
- restart node-local-dns (daemonset) and CoreDNS to flush caches.
- change kubelet flag on rolling nodes: --resolv-conf=/run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf (or the upstream resolv.conf that lists cluster DNS as first) OR point to the host file that has cluster DNS first.
- add iptables redirect for UDP/53 on nodes to force queries to 10.96.0.10 (ugly but immediate).

kai: tried restarting node-local-dns on one node -> pods still queried 127.0.0.53 but node-local-dns forwards to cluster DNS. However systemd-resolved still returned the stale external record for some queries. Flushing systemd cache fixed it for that node: `sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches` -> subsequent queries returned 10.0.5.12.

maria: any risk rolling back the node image? we should be careful in prod.

jon: I'm going to roll back the staging batch to the previous image (small batch) and pin kubelet resolv-conf until we patch image. Also will add a DaemonSet job to run `systemd-resolve --flush-caches` after image bootstrap while we validate.

kai: created an alert in PagerDuty: DNS-RESOLVER-MISMATCH when pod /etc/resolv.conf nameserver[0] != cluster DNS IP. Will also add a dashboard for mismatch count by region.

infra-bot: rollback job started for staging pool (batch revert -> older-ami-202602). Progress: 6/30 nodes rolled back.

jon: rollback done for first 6 nodes; ran `systemctl restart node-local-dns` and `systemd-resolve --flush-caches` on each. Confirmed pod nslookup now returns internal IP on those nodes.

alex: writeup suggestion for postmortem: explain cause (systemd-resolved stub taking precedence), why stale external records persisted (cache/TTL/ndots/search interaction), mitigations (kubelet --resolv-conf pin, image fix, monitoring/alerting, daemonset flush), and longer-term: ensure node image preserves a non-stub resolv.conf or switch kubelet to always point to the upstream resolv.conf path.

kai: sounds good. Action items: jon to patch rollout docs + pin kubelet flag, infra to update image build to keep resolv.conf upstream, ops to add alert/dash. I'm going to roll the mitigation to the rest of staging. :white_check_mark:

jon: I'll follow up with a PR for the kubelet kubeadm config and open infra ticket to fix image builder. Will post links when done.

kai: thanks all — monitoring looks stable on reverted nodes. Closing here but will keep the alert open until image fix goes through. :thumbsup:
